question: does adding a direction margin to the CE objective improve free generation on the direction shape

pools.note: C pools plus twelve new direction facts; both arms read the same four pools in the same order

arms.margin: CE + beta * direction margin, same pools and sampling

margin.betaSource: 0.3 share of the CE gradient norm, measured on the training batch without updates (job 241202)
margin.mStatus: hyperparameter under test, not a quality bar

holdout.entities: disjoint from the training facts and from the six confirmed rows
holdout.status: this round only; not broad generalisation

primaryFreeGeneration.rule: the margin arm must get the direction right on at least 6 of 8 holdout rows and beat the CE arm by at least 2 rows; entities, state and syntax must not be worse
primaryFreeGeneration.note: a wider score gap alone does not pass

oldSets.rule: no new human-confirmed fact loss on cf24, final24 or moved24 relative to C in the margin arm; added text and syntax reported item by item and not offset by the gap
oldSets.auxiliary: margin widening on the six confirmed rows and on the holdout is recorded, and cannot compensate for a generation regression

acceptance.reporting: all three seeds reported per arm; no averaging that hides a failing seed

failConditions: the score gap widens but free generation does not improve
the direction improves while new fact losses appear
